$comment: Conformance vectors for the VayuWeb registry. Generated by registry/scripts/generate-vectors.ts — do not edit by hand. Each vector is a record in hex, the registry state to verify it against, the instant to verify it at, and the verdict every conforming implementation must return. The rejection CODE is part of the contract, not just the outcome: a record with two defects must produce the same code everywhere, which is what makes check order testable across implementations.

notes.clock: now is a Unix timestamp in seconds. Vectors never depend on the wall clock of the machine running them.
notes.proofOfWork: state.powVerified injects the result of proof-of-work verification rather than requiring a 64 MiB Argon2id evaluation per vector. The proof construction has its own vectors, with real solved nonces, in the implementation test suite.
notes.keys: Fixed test keys, derived from all-0x42 and all-0x77 seeds. Not secret. Never to be used for anything real.
notes.suites: record pins what a verifier accepts. convergence, resolution and replication pin what implementations must AGREE about after that, which is where a fork lives — every consensus-critical defect found in this project so far was invisible to record verification and visible only to the question "what would a second implementation do".

vectors.name: schema/valid-registration
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REGISTER: a well-formed first registration of a free name

vectors.name: schema/unsupported-version
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: a verifier MUST reject a major version it does not implement

vectors.name: schema/unknown-operation
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: the operation set is closed

vectors.name: schema/uppercase-label
vectors.rule: NAMES.md: labels are lowercase [a-z0-9-]

vectors.name: schema/leading-hyphen
vectors.rule: NAMES.md: a label may not begin with a hyphen

vectors.name: schema/unratified-tld
vectors.rule: NAMES.md: the TLD must be a member of the Namespace Annex

vectors.name: schema/annex-first-entry
vectors.rule: VWIP-0004: the first Annex entry in sort order is ratified

vectors.name: schema/annex-last-entry
vectors.rule: VWIP-0004: the last Annex entry in sort order is ratified

vectors.name: schema/annex-two-letter-entry
vectors.rule: VWIP-0004: two-letter extensions are ratified despite colliding with ccTLD strings

vectors.name: schema/malformed-tld-is-unknown-not-malformed
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: the wire has one TLD rule — membership — and it subsumes shape

vectors.name: schema/small-order-owner-key
vectors.rule: A small-order point certifies signatures its holder never produced

vectors.name: schema/pow-carrying-cost-parameters
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: powProof is {alg, nonce, bits}; cost parameters are protocol constants

vectors.name: schema/pow-carrying-salt
vectors.rule: PROOF-OF-WORK.md: the salt is derived from the record, never carried by it

vectors.name: schema/alias-beside-another-entry
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: a name is either a pointer or a destination

vectors.name: schema/unknown-entry-type-is-retained
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: unknown entry types are stored and replicated unchanged

vectors.name: schema/unknown-top-level-field-is-retained
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: a record carrying unknown fields still verifies downstream

vectors.name: register/term-must-be-exactly-one-year
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REGISTER: notAfter - notBefore == 31536000

vectors.name: register/name-already-held
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REGISTER: the name must be free

vectors.name: register/after-quarantine-the-name-is-free-again
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: free means past notAfter plus 30 days grace plus 30 days quarantine

vectors.name: register/backdated
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REGISTER: notBefore at most 86400 seconds behind the clock

vectors.name: register/clock-skew-is-deferred-not-rejected
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: a postdated record is held, since the verifier clock may be behind

vectors.name: register/seq-must-be-zero
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REGISTER: seq == 0 and prevHash all-zero

vectors.name: register/unproven-work-is-refused
vectors.rule: PROOF-OF-WORK.md: the verifier recomputes the requirement and checks the tag

vectors.name: chain/valid-update
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md UPDATE: a live predecessor, owner-signed, notAfter unchanged

vectors.name: chain/no-predecessor
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: every operation but REGISTER needs an accepted predecessor

vectors.name: chain/sequence-gap
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: seq == prev.seq + 1, exactly

vectors.name: chain/replayed-record
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: replay fails because seq is no longer next

vectors.name: chain/substituted-predecessor
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: prevHash binds a record to the exact bytes of its predecessor

vectors.name: chain/minimum-interval
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: notBefore >= prev.notBefore + 300

vectors.name: authority/signed-by-another-key
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: sig must verify against prev.ownerKey

vectors.name: authority/silent-owner-change
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: only TRANSFER may change ownerKey

vectors.name: authority/transfer-without-countersignature
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md TRANSFER: coSig must verify under the incoming ownerKey

vectors.name: authority/valid-transfer
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md TRANSFER: outgoing owner signs, incoming owner countersigns

vectors.name: authority/revoked-name-accepts-nothing
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md REVOKE: no later record for the name is ever accepted

vectors.name: lifecycle/renew-inside-grace
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md RENEW: prev live or within its 30-day grace period

vectors.name: lifecycle/renew-after-grace-is-refused
vectors.rule: Quarantine exists so that nobody may take the name during it, including the holder

vectors.name: lifecycle/renewal-before-the-window-opens
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md RENEW: the window opens 60 days before expiry

vectors.name: lifecycle/renewal-cannot-buy-an-unbounded-term
vectors.rule: clock_check applies to every operation, not to REGISTER alone

vectors.name: lifecycle/update-must-not-move-the-expiry
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md UPDATE: notAfter == prev.notAfter

vectors.name: lifecycle/release-expires-immediately
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md RELEASE: records empty and notAfter == notBefore

vectors.name: lifecycle/only-renew-may-carry-a-proof
vectors.rule: REGISTRY.md: rec.op != RENEW and rec.powProof != null -> UNEXPECTED_POW

convergence.name: converge/smaller-digest-wins
convergence.rule: REGISTRY.md: otherwise, the smaller record_hash as a big-endian unsigned integer wins

convergence.name: converge/order-does-not-decide
convergence.rule: REGISTRY.md: a peer MUST NOT use its own log position or arrival order

resolution.name: resolve/pointer-beats-snapshot
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md: with several content entries present, select ipns before cid

resolution.name: resolve/snapshot-without-pointer
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md: cid is the content source when no pointer is present

resolution.name: resolve/txt-is-never-a-source
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md: a txt entry is never a content source

resolution.name: resolve/unratified-tld
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md step 2: only a member of the Namespace Annex is resolved

resolution.name: resolve/subdomains-are-refused-not-guessed
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md step 1: more than two dot-separated components is refused

resolution.name: resolve/unsynchronised-is-not-absent
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md step 7: no verified head gives 1502, not 1404

resolution.name: resolve/absent-name
resolution.rule: RESOLUTION.md step 7: a synchronised resolver reports an unregistered name as 1404

replication.name: replicate/hello
replication.rule: REPLICATION.md 3.2: HELLO carries the protocol version, log length and tree root

replication.name: replicate/batch-over-the-limit
replication.rule: REPLICATION.md 5: a batch larger than 256 is refused at decode

replication.name: replicate/unknown-type
replication.rule: REPLICATION.md 3.2: an unknown message type is named as unknown
